admission.justification: Keeping body/evidence out of wake text prevents an unbounded payload from consuming the recipient context.

applicability: The native text payload of a filed role_message delivery.
conditions: A complete message file was published before the send.
exclusions: Developer chat text and native host chat display
Messages via removed earlier orchestration tools
A body/attachment-free wake-up receives no file pointer line.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_paseo_role_messages.py (messageFile/sha, wake/file-line composition, self-message); checks-attempt4/pytest-focused.log; worker report Attempt 4

statement: A message wakes its recipient behind a sender line with the wake text and, where a file belongs, one last line naming the file and its SHA-256; the payload itself travels as files.
